title: Places: The Hidden Sanctuary
template:
Hidden deep within the [scenic_adjective] mountains lies a secret courtyard. The air smells like fresh rain and blooming jasmine. In the center of this space sits a fountain carved from a single piece of [precious_material].

The water bubbles forth with a [sound_adjective] sound that echoes against the stone walls. Tiny schools of glowing fish dart through the ripples. Legend says that drinking from this source grants the traveler a sudden burst of [abstract_quality].

You reach out your hand and feel the [mist_temperature] mist cooling your skin. Suddenly, a [mystical_creature] emerges from the shadows to take a sip. The creature nods at you before disappearing back into the thick foliage.

As the sun begins to set, the fountain glows with a soft [ethereal_color] light. You feel a sense of profound peace washing over your heart. Walking away, you promise to return to this magical sanctuary very soon.

blanks.hint: a type of stone or rare material
an adjective describing feeling or temperature
